text:
incident-bot: ALERT: PagerDuty incident #INC-371234 for service 'inference-prod' triggered: high error-rate (5xx) from region us-east-1. Routed to 'platform-oncall'.

mike: Looks like this got routed to platform-oncall but alert is for 'redwood-dedicated' — config mismatch?

sarah: @mike I see platform-oncall acked, but they're not the right team. Paging rules changed last night? :eyes: 

oncall-night: Acked to stop noise; we're investigating, but can someone confirm correct service tag?

priya: I'm on it, pulling PD routing. PD shows service tag 'inference-prod' mapped to 'platform-oncall' due to recent alias 'inference' created by infra-cfg job.

mike: This is customer-facing. CS reported SLO alerts. We should reassign to 'inference-runtime' and notify CS. Creating a PD reroute now.

carol: FYI: customers ondedicated-corp experiencing 502s, impact ~5% of requests per PG. Triage note added.

mike: ```
# run in infra tools
pd-cli reroute --incident 371234 --to inference-runtime
```

pagerduty-bot: Command accepted. Incident 371234 reassigned to 'inference-runtime'. Escalation policy set to primary then secondary.

robin: Got it, taking ownership. Kicking off quick check: rolling back last config at 03:10 UTC? Investigating KV cache eviction changes.

priya: I can confirm a CI job auto-deployed a change to routing rules `infra-routing:v2.1.5` at 02:58 UTC. Rolling that back now.

oncall-night: Thanks. Also we should update rotation binding so future pages go to inference-runtime. Priya, can you open a quick PR or hotfix?

priya: Opening PR: https://git.internal/routing/PR/4627 — will hotfix to remove alias mapping. ETA 8m :construction_worker: 

carol: CS notified: sent message to customers with impacted region, asking to expect intermittent 502s. Using template: 'We're aware...' 

robin: I've tailing logs, seeing spike in 5xx from model server 3. Index errors correlate with the routing change. Taking node out of LB for now.

mike: Manual mitigation: remove node, restart model worker. Also set temporary fallback to model-quantized variant to reduce errors.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Incident 371234 reassigned and mitigation in progress. PagerDuty notes appended. Status: investigating -> mitigation

sarah: Can someone add a brief impact summary: number of customers, estimated % requests, affected models? CS needs it for postmortem.

carol: Impact: ~3 customers, 5% of inference requests in us-east-1, models: gptx-8 and quantized-8 fallback used. No data loss. ETA to full restore 20m

robin: Model worker restarted, errors dropping. Monitoring: 5xx rate back to baseline. Rolling back config completed by priya.

priya: Hotfix merged and deployed. PR 4627 merged. Routing config reverted.

pagerduty-bot: INC-371234 status changed: acknowledged by inference-runtime (robin).

mike: Great. Assigning postmortem owner: @sarah. Please include timeline, root cause (alias created by infra-cfg job), mitigation steps, and action to prevent alias drift.

sarah: On it. I'll draft and share in #postmortems. Also schedule a retro with infra-cfg owners and routing team.

oncall-night: One last check: confirm rotation/roster corrected so that future pages route to 'inference-runtime' primary. Priya?

priya: Confirmed updated rotation binding and added test alert. Also added a unit test in our CI to catch alias-to-service mappings. :white_check_mark: 

incident-bot: Incident 371234 status: mitigated. Please continue monitoring for 30m.

carol: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone. Closing thread when CS acknowledges.

mike: Closing on my end. Good triage. Will add tags: paging-misroute, pd-routing, customer-impact.
